evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive commanding erasure of knowledge enacts authority-ranking: the speaker issues a command expecting compliance by rank, not reciprocity or shared identity.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Bare imperative commanding removal enacts authority-ranking: a directive issued without negotiation or reciprocity framing, performing hierarchical control over what the recipient may know.
